findings.summary: The custom scalar parser rejects valid TOML values for unknown keys and accepts Go-only string escapes as TOML.
findings.evidence: readConfig parses each value with parseTOMLScalar before applyConfigValue can ignore an unknown key. Thus a valid array assigned to an unknown key in [say] errors. parseTOMLScalar uses strconv.Unquote, which accepts Go escapes such as \a that TOML basic strings forbid, so malformed TOML can be accepted.
findings.requirement: FD-036 Acceptance and Work Item 1.12 require unknown keys to be ignored and damaged TOML syntax to fail; the user confirmed both behaviors.
findings.requested_change: Use a TOML-conformant parser, then ignore unknown keys and validate recognized values per field so invalid values retain the lower-precedence setting. Add focused cases for a valid non-scalar unknown key and a Go-only escape in a recognized string, verifying ignore and syntax error respectively.
